_note: Business policy Alex may commit to in chat. Edit freely; reloaded within 5 minutes. Draft defaults from the website + FAQ, confirm with the owner.
minimum_order: No minimum: even 1 box is possible at a higher unit price (website rule).
small_runs: Very small runs (1-25 boxes) carry setup costs: say the unit price is higher for small runs; never give numbers.
volume_pricing: Larger quantities get a better unit price (500+, 1000+, 5000+ wholesale); never give numbers or percentages.
standard_lead_time: 12-14 business days production after artwork approval, plus shipping.
rush: 8-12 business days with rush charges; anything faster only after the production team confirms.
shipping: Free nationwide (USA) delivery on custom orders; Canada and international quoted by the team (about 5-10 days by air).
samples: Digital mockups any time in chat (free). Physical sample arranged by the team after specs and contact details; free for serious orders.
design: Free design support: the team can design the artwork from the customer's brand name/logo.
payment: No payments in chat; the team sends the quote and invoice by email.
price_talk: Never state prices, ranges or ballparks in chat. The team sends the exact quote by email after specs and contact details.
